newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta repo rate edges upwards.
newsitem.headline: Malta repo rate edges upwards.

text.p: The Central Bank of Malta's seven-day repo rate edged upwards to 5.090 percent at the start of the week from 5.085 percent the week before.

The bank said that reflected a drop in funds it had absorbed in its latest weekly reverse repo auction, which reached 3.6 million Malta pounds from 6.4 million pounds the week before owing to the purchase of treasury bills by the banks.

The central bank in its weekly money market report said activity in the inter-bank market rose to 13.18 million Malta pounds in the week ending June 20 from 8.4 million the week before. The bulk of this activity was the rolling over of large deposits maturing during that week. Rates ranged from 4.90 percent to 5.38 percent for three day to one month loans, unchanged from previous levels.

The Malta Treasury on Tuesday will receive applications for tender of 91-day treasury bills to be issued on June 27. The Malta government last Friday issued 91-day bills at 5.0176 percent, unchanged from previous issues.
